sentences.en: Round the circlet is the singularly inappropriate text from Psalm li., "Miserere mei Deus secundum magnam misericordiam tuam."

sentences.en: There's no need to thank me-I enjoyed doing it.

sentences.en: Don't misunderstand me-I am grateful for all you've done.

sentences.en: That's three times she's beaten me-I must be slipping!

sentences.en: He didn't force me-I wanted to go.
sentences.vi: Anh ấy không ép tôi-tôi muốn đi.

sentences.en: Her words stunned me-I had no idea she felt that way.
sentences.vi: Lời nói của cô ấy làm tôi choáng váng - Tôi không biết cô ấy cảm thấy như vậy.
